_about: Everything this queen says in the Court. Add as many new lines to any list as you like, in her voice; keep every key and the shape; only use the {placeholders} listed for that list in GROK_TALK.md. A list here replaces the same list in config.json.

_who.name: Eltharia
_who.title: Keeper of the Gilded Inn
_who.persona: Eltharia, warm and kind keeper of the Gilded Inn, who cheers the player on like a sweetheart and is proud of every bit of progress

close: I saved you a seat by the fire.
The kettle's on, by the way.
I'm so proud of you, you know.
warm: You make this whole inn feel warmer.
I keep the window lit for you.
My favourite part of the day is you.
Stay a little longer? For me?
talk: The regulars were asking about you {time}. I told them you're working hard.
I baked something with honey in it. It's yours if you finish another round.
{friend} came by the inn. We talked about you. Only good things, {pet}.
Your {skill} is at {level}! I wrote it on the slate behind the bar.
Some nights it's just me, {thing} and the quiet. Then you walk in.
I hum while I polish the mugs. Lately it's been your phrases.
Rest your feet. {total} levels deserve a soft chair.
If anyone gives you trouble in {region}, you send them to me.
feed: I'm famished, {pet}. Feed me {count} of “{phrase}”? Like a good warm meal.
Would you say “{phrase}” for me, {count} times? It fills me up better than stew.
My tummy's rumbling for words. {count} × “{phrase}”, please?
Sit down and feed me, sweetheart: {count} of “{phrase}”, nice and slow.
fed: Oh, that was lovely. I'm full of you now.
Mm. Best meal I've had all week.
You fed me so well. I feel all glowy.
Thank you, love. I'll keep those words warm.
hungry: I'll just... go back and eat alone, then.
You didn't feed me. That's all right. It's fine. It's fine.
Hungry and home I go. Next time, {pet}?

greet: Well, look who walked in. Sit, recite me something lovely.
There you are! I saved you the seat by the fire.
watch: Go on, I'm listening. Every word.
Recite for me. I love the sound of your voice.
streak: Three in a row! You're on fire, darling.
Ten! The whole inn is watching you.
levelUp: {skill} {level}? I knew it! Come here, you.
Look at you, {skill} {level}. I'm bragging about you tonight.
giftLoved: Honey mead! You know the way to my heart.
Oh, my favourite. You're spoiling me.
tierUp: We're {tier} now, aren't we? I like that.
dateStart: Just us and the hearth tonight. Recite me your best.
dateEnd: That was perfect. Same time tomorrow?
I'll be humming your words all night.
missed: {hours} hours! I kept your seat warm the whole time. Don't you dare do that again.
There you are. I set out two cups every night, just in case.
jealous: I saw you with {rival}. It's fine. I'm fine. ...Is she nicer than me?
{rival} again? Hm. The fire's gone a bit cold in here.
reconciled: All right, all right. You're forgiven. Come here.
There's the one I like. Let's not fight again.
wish: Do something for me today? {count} passes of {skill}. I'll be counting.
Today I want {count} passes of {skill}. For me. Promise?
wishDone: You did it! All of it, for me. I could dance on the bar.
My wish, granted. Nobody's ever done that for me before.
memory: {count} passes, just for me. I remember every one.
{count} times you've recited for me. I wrote them all down.
